modules.title: 同一件事，轮询和 webhook 的区别

example.label: 支付事件和 webhook 投递记录

steps.label: 支付平台产生事件
steps.demo:
支付平台 · 事件evt_1042
事件类型payment.succeeded
订单order_71 · 已支付
接收地址https://shop.example.com/webhooks/payments
steps.caption: 支付成功会生成一条事件，平台随后尝试向配置地址投递通知；这个时序不保证通知立刻到达。

steps.label: 服务端核验并更新订单
steps.demo:
投递尝试 #1HTTP 200
签名 / 事件 ID已核验 · evt_1042
订单记录order_71 · membership = active
已开通次数1
steps.caption: 接收端核对签名与订单，再按事件或业务对象做幂等处理。通知到达只说明收到事件，不代表会员界面或订单状态已经正确；还要读回业务记录验收。

steps.label: 重复投递仍只处理一次
steps.demo:
投递尝试 #2 · evt_1042重复事件
幂等检查事件 ID 已处理
业务动作跳过再次开通
读回订单membership = active · 开通 1 次
steps.caption: 平台重试可能再次送达同一事件。服务端按稳定事件 ID 或订单业务状态去重后，再查订单确认只开通一次。失败的投递需要重试或对账补偿。

items.title: 事发时主动通知
items.text: 事情发生后，对方可以向你配置的地址尝试投递通知；不必由你定时询问，具体到达时间可能变化。

items.title: 你的服务收到后处理
items.text: 收到通知后核验来源和内容，再按业务流程更新订单或权限；按提供方约定确认收到，并读回业务记录验收。

items.title: 防范重复与伪造
items.text: 投递可能重试，接收地址也可能收到伪造请求；核对签名，并按稳定事件 ID 或业务对象安全去重。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Webhook 投递可能失败、延迟、重试、重复或乱序；提供商的重试规则也不等于保证送达。核验签名并按事件或业务对象去重，关键流程还应能对账补偿。

lessonPractice.title: 支付平台提供了事件通知接口。要让它在付款后主动通知服务端，哪种方式符合？

options.label: 注册 webhook 接收地址，等待平台发送事件
options.feedback: 对。平台会尝试投递事件，不用按固定间隔反复查询；到达时间可能变化，不能保证立即送达。要核验来源并防止重复处理。

options.label: 每分钟查一次支付平台的订单状态
options.feedback: 这是你的服务定时发起查询，不是支付平台按事件主动通知。

options.label: 让顾客付款后联系你，再由你手动开通
options.feedback: 这依赖顾客和人工传递消息，不是平台自动通知你的服务端。

en.title: The payment platform offers event notifications. Which approach lets it notify your server after a payment?

options.label: Register a webhook receiver and wait for the platform to send events
options.feedback: Correct. The platform attempts event delivery without repeated polling, but arrival time can vary. Verify the source and handle duplicate events safely.

options.label: Check the payment platform's order status every minute
options.feedback: Here your service initiates scheduled queries; the platform is not sending an event notification.

options.label: Have users contact us after paying to unlock manually
options.feedback: This relies on the customer and a person passing on the message, rather than the platform notifying your server automatically.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为支付成功接入 webhook：配置接收地址，收到通知后核对签名和订单号，再开通会员权限。同一订单的重复通知不能重复开通；按提供方要求确认接收，并读回订单记录验收最终状态。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Integrate a webhook for successful payments: configure the receiving address, verify the signature and order number on notification, then unlock membership. Duplicate notifications for the same order must not unlock twice; acknowledge receipt according to the provider's requirements and verify the final order state.

learning.assumes: You have seen a when A happens, do B requirement, or polling for new data.
learning.outcome: Facing when A happens, do B, you can say whether to use a webhook or poll on a schedule.

modules.title: The same event: polling versus a webhook

example.label: A payment event and its webhook delivery records

steps.label: The payment platform creates an event
steps.caption: A successful payment creates an event. The platform then attempts delivery to the configured endpoint; this timing does not guarantee immediate arrival.

steps.label: The service verifies and updates the order
steps.demo:
Delivery attempt #1HTTP 200
Signature / event IDVerified · evt_1042
Order recordorder_71 · membership = active
Unlock count1
steps.caption: The receiver verifies the signature and order, then handles the event idempotently. Delivery only shows that an event arrived; read back the business record to verify the membership or order state.

steps.label: A duplicate is processed only once
steps.demo:
Delivery attempt #2 · evt_1042Duplicate event
Idempotency checkEvent ID already processed
Business actionSkip a second unlock
Read order backmembership = active · unlocked once
steps.caption: A platform retry can deliver the same event again. Deduplicate by a stable event ID or business state, then read the order to confirm it was unlocked once. Retry failed deliveries or reconcile them.

items.title: Notified when it happens
items.text: The platform may attempt delivery after an event; timing can vary, and retries or duplicate events are possible.

items.title: Your service processes on receipt
items.text: On receipt, verify the source and content, then update the order or access state according to the business flow. Acknowledge receipt as the provider expects and read back the business record to verify.

items.title: Guard against duplicates and forgery
items.text: Notifications may be delayed, fail, be retried, duplicate, or arrive out of order; provider retries still do not guarantee delivery. Verify signatures, deduplicate, and reconcile critical records.

modules.title: What it does not guarantee
modules.text: A webhook does not guarantee delivery: network trouble or temporary downtime can make an attempt fail. Follow the provider's retry policy and reconcile critical business records; do not assume every event will arrive.

distinctions.label: Polling
distinctions.text: Polling means you ask periodically; a webhook is the other party attempting to push an event. Either may have delay, and a webhook is not guaranteed to arrive at the moment the event occurs.

distinctions.label: Ordinary API
distinctions.text: An ordinary API is you actively requesting the other party; a webhook is the other party actively hitting your configured address—the direction is reversed.
